non_drive_sources.note: Ryan Lisac (6, INBOX) + Kristin Shaelene (5, PENDING). No timestamp overlap with Drive data; appended as extension.

dedupe_rules: Duplicate Drive generations of the same Facebook export (4 folder IDs with identical 403 thread names) parsed once.
Within/between FB and IG exports: records deduped on (canonical participant-set key, timestamp-to-second, normalized sender, text). 13 cross-export dupes removed.
Canonical thread key = frozenset of normalized participant names, so the same conversation matches across FB and IG exports despite different folder naming schemes.
Facebook system thread (messenger_wztjyja3ka, 2 promo records, 2019-01-15) retained, flagged non-personal.
exclusions: Confrontation Over Phone Messages (~17.6MB): Gemini/AI-Studio prompt artifact (video transcription analysis), not a message archive.
messages_export / messages / MASTER_MESSAGES_DB_DUMP / interspersed_messages spreadsheets: phone/iMessage datasets, not Messenger/IG/TikTok.
12 of 403 Facebook Google Docs parsed to zero messages (attachment/call-only threads).
coverage_gaps: Facebook Messenger 2022-09-05 to 2026-08-13: no export covers this window; Dan's 2026-09-12 screen recording shows ~38 active threads Oct 2022-present (Danielle Onesi Mar 2025, Ally Lubin request Mar 2024, Josh Brannan Jul 2024, Suzanne Frank Aug 2026, TOM Jul 2026, etc.).
Instagram DMs 2025-08-10 to present: not covered.
E2EE-default threads (post-late-2023) are invisible to the companion CLI sync path; a fresh Facebook DYI export with messages checked is still the authoritative route for the gap.
